newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr to test downside in Asia, focus on Japan data.
newsitem.headline: Dlr to test downside in Asia, focus on Japan data.

text.p: The dollar is likely to test its downside against the yen in Asia on Wednesday, with market participants looking towards Japan's current account data for May, due for release at 2350 GMT (Tuesday), dealers said.

"Active dollar sales will likely emerge if Japan's current account surplus grows by a large amount," a trust bank dealer said. "The undertone of the dollar is bearish, with the market more keen to react on dollar-selling factors."
Dealers said the dollar was already capped slightly above 113 yen from early trade on light interbank sales, but many participants were taking a wait-and-see stance before the data.
